paragraphs.text: Scarmaker is a kami from Kamigawa who was active during the Kami War .

He was initially a human warrior working as a hired muscle, but betrayed the humans, joining the side of the kami and turning into one himself. As a kami, Scarmaker has a powerful, scaled, and scarred physique and a terrifying face marked with glowing red skin and sharp teeth. Massive sloth-like claws protrude from his hands.
